question.text: A client's ONLY equity LTCG in FY is Rs. 2 lakh (held 18 months). Post-Jul 2024 LTCG tax payable:

explanation.text: The Logic: Taxable = (2,00,000 - 1,25,000) = 75,000. Tax at 12.5% = Rs. 9,375. The Trap: Rs. 25,000 taxes the full Rs. 2 lakh without exemption; 12,500 uses 10%. Cross-Exam Context: Current tax post-Jul 2024. Manager's Pro-Tip: LTCG harvesting up to Rs. 1.25 lakh annually is tax-free — plan realisations accordingly.
